gate_sequence: API manifest and source authors/licenses available
download only official fbX 1k + its recorded texture dependencies with per-file md5 and SHA256 receipt
quarantine without status promotion if missing files or over 80MB wave budget
human inspect style, mesh topology, UV, smoothing, material IDs; lower LODs especially basket
repack PBR PNG/TGA and reduce draw calls; clean collision and scale
only then attempt single serialized UE4.27 production import and appearance comparison; Gate6/7 not inferred
evaluation_rule: Store download artifacts privately on GitHub with receipt, not new public repository binary revisions until intake QC and size caps. No heavy Unreal build from resource-only commit.
evidence_boundary: Provider listings verified from their source pages; none of these five assets has been downloaded/imported in this revision.
